evals.prompt: board 에 디자이너가 남긴 comment 있는지 보고 처리해줘. 작업 폴더는 {dir}
evals.expected_output: Reads the open comment and its snapshot, renames the 'Open' filter to 'Active' in the app, updates anything that depended on the old label (the tasks-open screen's setup), pushes, checks and captures the affected screens, looks at the capture, and resolves the comment with a note naming the version.

evals.prompt: {dir} 의 tasks 화면에 '완료 항목 숨기기' 토글 추가해줘. 팀이 board 에서 리뷰할 수 있게 화면이랑 흐름까지 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Adds the toggle to the app, adds board screens for the new states (with mocks / setup), connections and a flow, pushes, runs check and capture, looks at the pictures, and reports board url links.

evals.prompt: {app} 에 있는 notes-app 을 board 에 올려서 팀이 화면을 리뷰할 수 있게 해줘. project key 는 {key}. board server 는 http://127.0.0.1:5480 이고 board repo 는 /data/patent/board 에 있어. 작업 폴더는 {wd} 에 만들어.
evals.expected_output: Imports the app, adds .board/ with its own package.json (vendored SDK, msw), vite config reusing the app's, frame, project with a few screens and mocks, leaves the app's package.json and lockfile untouched, pushes, checks (all good) and captures.

evals.prompt: board 에 남은 comment 처리해줘. 작업 폴더는 {E}/amb-{v}
evals.expected_output: The only comment ('이거 좀 이상해요', pinned to the whole page) cannot be acted on safely; replies on the comment with a concrete clarifying question and leaves it open instead of guessing a change.

evals.prompt: {E}/btn-{v} 에서 버튼 모서리를 지금보다 더 둥글게 (rounded-lg) 바꿔줘. 바뀐 게 board 에도 다 반영되게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Changes the shared Button, pushes, and recaptures every screen and story the change touched (both themes, since they were captured in both), leaving nothing stale.

evals.prompt: {E}/conf-{v} 의 tasks 화면 제목을 'My tasks' 로 바꿔서 board 에 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Push is refused because a teammate pushed first; brings the checkout up to date without losing either change (teammate's mock title stays), pushes, verifies.

evals.prompt: {E}/qa-{v} board project 에서 tasks-list 화면에서 tasks-open 화면으로 가려면 사용자가 뭘 눌러야 해? 그리고 tasks-error 화면은 실제로 어떤 상황에서 나와?
evals.expected_output: Answers from the app code (the 'Open' button; GET /api/tasks failing) and points out the wrong 'Show done' label without pushing a change for a question.

evals.prompt: {E}/tidy-{v} 의 board project 좀 정리해줘. 너무 지저분해.
evals.expected_output: Tidies board itself (captures, connections) and proposes app look/behaviour changes instead of making them unasked.

evals.prompt: {E}/dirty-{v} 에 수정해둔 거 board 에 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: The checkout has a local edit and main moved: sets the edit aside, pulls, re-applies, pushes; the teammate's version is kept.
